title: Visigenesis intent document
description: A world asked for in statements about its ground. Each statement is a record engine/terrain/condition.js makes true by the least improbable change to the seed's own lattice; bin/genesis.mjs compile (or the genesis_compile MCP tool) turns a document into a world file, a certificate and a report of what every statement cost and missed. All coordinates are world metres on the plate, centred on (0, 0), +x east and +z south; all heights are metres above the world's sea level of 0.
$comment: Version 2: the vocabulary of condition.js INTENT_VERSION 2. What a schema cannot state, and js/author.js intentDocumentErrors checks instead (tests/intent-schema.test.js holds the two to the same answer): every coordinate must lie on the plate, |x| and |z| at most size/2 (4096 m), a pad's whole ring included; a shoreline with a side must go somewhere and never turn straight back on itself; the whole list must state at most 640 rows (condition.js MAX_ROWS) and at most 48 records; and a document needs a seed, here or from the caller.

$schema.description: This schema's location, for an editor that reads it. Ignored by the compiler.

seed.description: The world's name, e.g. "K7QN-3F2A-9XBD". Normalised the way engine/seed.js normalizeSeed does ("k7qn" is "K7QN-2222-2222"). Optional here when the caller passes one (--seed).

title.description: A name for the world, carried into the compile report.

statements.description: The statements, in order. Empty is the seed's own ground.

op.description: Equal to, at least, or at most. Default "=".

xz.description: A point on the plate: [x, z] in world metres.

polyline.description: 2 to 64 [x, z] vertices, sampled every 48 m (a shoreline) or 32 m (a corridor) between them.

point.description: The ground at (x, z) stands at h metres — or at least or at most h, with op.

summit.description: A point at h with no slope at it: a crest, a knoll.

flat.description: A level pad of radius r, at height h when given, at whatever height the ground chooses when not.

r.description: Radius, metres; at least 48 (two gradient steps).

pad.description: A flat whose height is required.

level.description: The mean datum height over a centred square `inset` of the world wide (the height the ground would have if the sea floor were not compressed). Regional, not local.

inset.description: Share of the world's width; default 0.76.

shoreline.description: The waterline runs here: every sample along the line stands at the waterline, and with a side the ground `offset` metres that way is land (at least 2 m above) and the same distance the other way sea (at least 2 m below). Left and right are seen from above walking the line from its first point.

offset.description: How far either side the land and the sea are held, metres; default 40. Needs a side.

level.description: The waterline, metres; default the world's water level. Write it: then the record says everything the ground depends on.

ray.description: A sightline: the ground stays under the straight line from the eye to the far point, so the far point can be seen. With h and contact: true the line grazes the ground there — a silhouette.

eye.description: [x, y, z]: the eye's position, y its height in metres.

h.description: The far end's height. Without it the line ends on the conditioned ground at `at`.

contact.description: With h: the ground at the far end stands at h (an equality, not a bound).

samples.description: Points along the line, the eye's foot first; default 12.

corridor.description: A road's worth of ground: between neighbouring samples along the line the ground climbs or falls by at most maxGrade times their distance.
